verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Weave captures cost per call and shows it in the trace tree and calls table. It also offers evaluation comparisons, visualizations, and leaderboards. None of this documents a custom dashboard builder for charting latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics together. These are adjacent views, not the user-built dashboards the story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
